name: Data.heightLe_norm_trivialLift_sq
summary: Write |Ξ|² as intAlgPart of a flat pair divided by the normalisation; intAlgPart is an algebraic integer (ℓ-adically ≤ 1) whose conjugates are bounded by the jet sizes.

steps.claim: A flat pair q for the index set of rank-one lifts with the trivial character (exists_isFlat).

Witnesses of the height: H' = intAlgPart(q)/|Ξ|², α = (bound below), e_ℓ = 0: the conjugates of H' are bounded via exists_algEquiv_norm_eq and the logarithmic bound of the norm of the trivial lift (log_norm_map_norm_sq_trivialLift), and H'·|Ξ|² = intAlgPart(q) is ℓ-integral (isIntegralMeasure_intAlgPart).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨q.intAlgPart h.2 .one / ‖trivialLift H.1 .one‖ ^ 2, _, 0, by simp,
    (P.exists_algEquiv_norm_eq · |>.elim fun σ e ↦
    (log_norm_map_norm_sq_trivialLift D (RankOneIndex p.z) σ).elim fun _ k ↦
    le_exp_of_log_le ?_), by simp [(isIntegralMeasure_intAlgPart ..).norm_apply_one_le], by aesop⟩

steps.claim: Instantiate the bound k for q and for the rank-one pair, and jetSize(w₀(τ)) ≤ jetSize(c_τ − z) + … (jetSize_le_add, w₀ ≤ c − z by rank one).
steps.lean:
obtain - := k, k _ h.2, k _ H.1, sum_mono fun τ ↦ D.jetSize_le_add
    (by cases j <;> grind [IsRankOne] : D.w 0 τ ≤ p.c τ - p.z + 0)

steps.claim: Unfold intAlgPart at the trivial twist, denomBound, logarithms and jetSize.
steps.lean: simp [h, Pair.intAlgPart, twist_one_spec, denomBound, log_mul, log_div, NeZero.ne, jetSize] at *

steps.claim: Unpack the hypotheses of the flat pairs.
steps.lean: rename_i a b _; obtain ⟨⟨_, _, _, _⟩, _, _, -, _⟩ := And.intro a b; simp only [e]

steps.claim: The exponents satisfy α ≤ B₀ − Σ jetSize(w₀): linear arithmetic with log Mk + f(8z log g + 8) ≤ B₀ (le_of_hasLogBound).
steps.lean:
linarith [(D.le_of_hasLogBound :
    Real.log D.chosenGroupOrder + D.f * (8 * q.z * Real.log D.gProd + 8) ≤ D.B₀)]
